facts.note: Nine o'clock bell; everyone shows watches; hers exact, Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, doctor 2 min ahead. Matches the sheet in every reading and relation.
After dinner she works beside the master in the atelier; at the ten o'clock strike the regulator agrees exactly with the bell.
He sends her downstairs when the regulator shows twenty past ten; it was running then and he was well.
In the kitchen she compares her watch with Rosa's clock, which is exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano begins at twelve minutes to eleven and stops at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock, heard from the kitchen.
She goes straight down to the kitchen and stays with Rosa from arrival until after the eleven o'clock strike.
